definitions.explanation: describes a melancholy atmosphere or feeling of isolation

examples.japanese: {侘|わび}しい{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし。
{冬|ふゆ}の{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れは{侘|わび}しい。
{古|ふる}い{旅館|りょかん}に{一人|ひとり}で{泊|と}まると{侘|わび}しい{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: Staying alone at an old inn makes me feel forlorn.

notes:
USAGE:
- {侘|わび}しい{生活|せいかつ} (dreary life)
- {侘|わび}しい{気持|きも}ち (lonely feeling)
- {侘|わび}しい{風景|ふうけい} (desolate scenery)

NUANCE:
Conveys a poetic, wistful loneliness rather than simple isolation. Often evokes imagery of autumn or winter, empty spaces, or solitary living.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Related to the aesthetic concept of {侘|わ}び (wabi) - finding beauty in simplicity and imperfection, though the adjective emphasizes the melancholy aspect more than the aesthetic appreciation.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {侘|わび}しく
- Noun form: {侘|わび}しさ (loneliness, dreariness)
